_about: APPROVED EN/KM strings for the KruMemory tool. This is the reviewed source of truth; the applied copy lives in src/lib/i18n/dictionary.ts. Values here were approved by the project owner.

_placeholders.{count}: a number (items remaining, or items in a deck)
_placeholders.{name}: the label the user typed for an item: a person's name, a word, a term
_placeholders.{collection}: the user-typed name of a collection (deck), e.g. People

_placeholders_km_note: DECIDED: Khmer mode uses Western digits for every runtime number ({count}, {number}, {accuracy}) and for the raw counters rendered outside this file. No Khmer-numeral conversion happens at the substitution point.
_do_not_translate: Collection names typed by the user (they are data, not copy)
_review_note: Every Khmer value marked 'Pending native-speaker review.' is machine-authored and has not yet been checked by a native speaker. That covers all the collection, item and picture wording added when the tool was generalised from faces to any picture+label pair.

auth.checking.where: Full-screen loading state while the account is verified. Shown before anything else, so it should feel calm and brief.
auth.checking.km: កំពុងពិនិត្យគណនី KruMath…

auth.signOut.where: Toolbar sign-out button. Used as both tooltip and screen-reader label, so keep it short.

account.label.where: Toolbar account menu: the avatar button's screen-reader label, and the fallback display name before the profile loads. km added for the account menu; pending native-speaker review.

account.settings.where: Item in the toolbar account menu -> krumath.com/settings. km added for the account menu; pending native-speaker review.
account.settings.km: ការកំណត់គណនី

nav.practice.where: App header tab -> the practice/home screen.

nav.items.where: App header tab -> the list of items in the deck currently in view. Replaces the old nav.people. Pending native-speaker review.

nav.language.where: Screen-reader label for the EN/KM button group. Never seen visually.

toolbar.home.where: Toolbar tooltip -> krumath.com/home. Purely an icon, so this text is the only description users get.
toolbar.home.km: ទំព័រដើម KruMath

toolbar.github.where: Toolbar tooltip -> the GitHub repository, opens in a new tab.

toolbar.pricing.where: Toolbar tooltip -> krumath.com/pricing. Playful coffee wording; the link still points at the pricing page.
toolbar.pricing.km: ទិញកាហ្វេឱ្យខ្ញុំមួយកែវហេ៎?

home.status.loading.where: Small status pill on the home screen while data loads.
home.status.loading.km: កំពុងផ្ទុក…

home.status.ready.where: Status pill once the deck in view has enough items to practise.
home.status.ready.km: រួចរាល់ក្នុងការអនុវត្ត

home.status.needMore.where: Status pill when the deck in view has fewer than 4 items. {count} is how many more are needed.
home.status.needMore.km: ត្រូវការ {count} ទៀតដើម្បីចាប់ផ្ដើម

home.title.where: The main headline. Two short parallel phrases for rhythm. 'The picture' is deliberately broad: a portrait, a photo of a formula, or a vocabulary image. Pending native-speaker review.
home.title.en: See the picture. Remember the name.
home.title.km: មើលរូបភាព ចាំឈ្មោះ

home.subtitle.where: One- or two-sentence explanation under the headline. Names several subjects on purpose so the tool reads as general-purpose rather than face-only. Pending native-speaker review.
home.subtitle.en: Whatever you keep mixing up — faces, words, symbols, formulas — practise until nothing slips away.
home.subtitle.km: អ្វីៗដែលអ្នកច្រើនច្រឡំ — មុខមនុស្ស ពាក្យថ្មី សញ្ញា រូបមន្ត — ហ្វឹកហាត់រហូតដល់មិនភ្លេចទៀត។

home.start.where: Primary button -> the quiz. Only shown when the deck in view has enough items.
home.start.km: ចាប់ផ្ដើមអនុវត្ត

home.addItems.where: Primary button -> the add-item screen. Shown instead of home.start when the deck in view has too few items.
home.addItems.km: បន្ថែមរបស់

home.accuracy.where: Label inside the stats pill, sitting next to a percentage like `82%`. Lowercase by design.
home.accuracy.km: ភាពត្រឹមត្រូវ

collections.label.where: Screen-reader label for the collection switcher. The deck names shown inside it are user data and are never translated. Pending native-speaker review.

collections.addFirst.where: Primary button on the home screen when the account has no decks at all yet, so there is nothing to switch between. Pending native-speaker review.
collections.addFirst.km: បន្ថែមរបស់ដំបូងរបស់អ្នក

items.title.where: Heading of the item list screen. Pending native-speaker review.
items.title.km: បញ្ជីរបស់អ្នក

items.count.where: Sub-line under the heading. {count} is the number of items in the deck and {collection} is the user's own name for it, so the word order has to survive a long deck name. Pending native-speaker review.
items.count.km: មាន {count} ក្នុង {collection}

items.add.where: Button -> add-item screen. Also reused inside the quiz when the deck in view has too few items. Pending native-speaker review.
items.add.km: បន្ថែមរបស់

items.empty.where: Empty state: the whole screen becomes one big button with this label. Pending native-speaker review.
items.empty.km: បន្ថែមរបស់ដំបូងរបស់អ្នក

items.remove.where: Tooltip on each card's X button. {name} is the item's label, so word order matters.

add.back.where: Button -> back to the item list.
add.back.km: ត្រលប់ក្រោយ

add.save.where: Button that uploads the picture and saves the item.

add.saveAll.where: Header save button when more than one pending photo is queued for batch upload.
add.saveAll.km: រក្សាទុកទាំងអស់

add.saving.where: Same button while the upload is in flight. Must read as an in-progress state.
add.saving.km: កំពុងរក្សាទុក…

add.savingProgress.where: Header save button while a batch upload is in flight. {done} and {total} are counts.
add.savingProgress.km: កំពុងរក្សាទុក {done}/{total}…

add.changePicture.where: Tooltip once a picture is chosen, inviting a replacement. Renamed from add.changePhoto. Pending native-speaker review.
add.changePicture.km: ប្ដូររូបភាព

add.choosePicture.where: Tooltip before any picture is chosen. Renamed from add.choosePhoto. Pending native-speaker review.
add.choosePicture.km: ជ្រើសរើសរូបភាព

add.dropHint.where: Hint under the empty photo drop zone inviting drag-and-drop or click.
add.dropHint.en: Drop photos here, or click to choose
add.dropHint.km: ទាញរូបភាពមកទីនេះ ឬចុចដើម្បីជ្រើស

add.uploadFolder.where: Secondary control that opens a folder picker (Chromium/Safari) to batch-add every image in a folder.
add.uploadFolder.km: ផ្ទុកថតឯកសារ

add.removePending.where: Screen-reader / button label to remove one photo from the batch review queue.

add.batchTooMany.where: Error when the dropped or picked set exceeds the soft cap. {max} is that number.
add.batchTooMany.km: រូបភាពច្រើនពេក (អតិបរមា {max})។

add.batchNone.where: Error when a folder or multi-select contained no image files.
add.batchNone.km: រកមិនឃើញឯកសាររូបភាព។

add.batchPartialFailed.where: Warning after a batch save where some rows failed. {saved} and {failed} are counts; failed rows stay in the queue.
add.batchPartialFailed.en: Saved {saved}, but {failed} failed. Fix and try again.
add.batchPartialFailed.km: រក្សាទុកបាន {saved} ប៉ុន្តែ {failed} បរាជ័យ។ សូមកែហើយព្យាយាមម្ដងទៀត។

add.selectedPicture.where: Screen-reader description of the chosen image. Never seen visually. Renamed from add.selectedPortrait. Pending native-speaker review.
add.selectedPicture.km: រូបភាពដែលបានជ្រើសរើស

add.namePlaceholder.where: Label field hint, and the field's screen-reader label. This is the answer the user has to recall, so it covers a person's name, a word, or a term. Pending native-speaker review.
add.namePlaceholder.km: ឈ្មោះ ឬស្លាក

add.collectionLabel.where: Label above the collection field: which deck the item is filed under. Pending native-speaker review.
add.collectionLabel.km: បញ្ជីឈ្មោះ

add.collectionPlaceholder.where: Hint inside the collection field, showing the kind of name to type. The value is an example, so it must not look like a required exact value. Pending native-speaker review.
add.collectionPlaceholder.en: e.g. Team roster or English verb group
add.collectionPlaceholder.km: ឧទាហរណ៍៖ បញ្ជីឈ្មោះក្រុមការងារ ឬ ក្រុមពាក្យកិរិយាអង់គ្លេស

add.collectionNew.where: Dashed chip when no deck is chosen yet; opens the name box. Also the screen-reader label for that box. Pending native-speaker review.

add.collectionEdit.where: Dashed chip when a deck is already chosen; opens the name box to change it. Pending native-speaker review.

add.collectionConfirm.where: Screen-reader label on the tick button that accepts a freshly typed deck name. The button is an icon, so this text is the only description. Pending native-speaker review.
add.collectionConfirm.km: ប្រើឈ្មោះនេះ

add.collectionCancel.where: Screen-reader label on the X that closes the new-deck name box and returns to the deck chips. Hidden when the account has no decks yet, because there is nothing to go back to. Pending native-speaker review.

add.collectionRequired.where: Quiet hint under the deck chips while no deck is chosen; it is the only explanation for the disabled Save button. Shown instead of add.collectionExisting. Pending native-speaker review.
add.collectionRequired.en: Choose a collection, or create one, to save this card.
add.collectionRequired.km: សូមជ្រើសរើសបញ្ជី ឬបង្កើតបញ្ជីថ្មី ដើម្បីរក្សាទុករបស់នេះ។

add.collectionExisting.where: Reassurance under the name box when what was typed matches a deck that already exists, so the card joins it instead of making a near-duplicate. {collection} is that deck's existing spelling. Pending native-speaker review.
add.collectionExisting.km: បញ្ជីនេះមានរួចហើយ — របស់នេះនឹងចូលក្នុង {collection}។

quiz.needMore_one.where: Shown when exactly 1 more item is needed. Kept as a separate key from the plural even though the two Khmer values are identical: English needs the distinction ("1 more item" vs "3 more items"), and quiz.tsx chooses the key by count === 1. Pending native-speaker review.
quiz.needMore_one.km: បន្ថែម {count} ទៀតដើម្បីអនុវត្ត

quiz.needMore_other.where: Shown when 2 or 3 more items are needed. {count} is that number. Pending native-speaker review.
quiz.needMore_other.km: បន្ថែម {count} ទៀតដើម្បីអនុវត្ត

quiz.back.where: Button -> home. Also the screen-reader label on that button.
quiz.back.km: ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ

quiz.question.where: Top-right progress text before any answer. {number} starts at 1.

quiz.progress.where: Top-right progress text once answering has begun. {accuracy} is a percentage, {count} is how many have been answered. The interpunct is part of the design - feel free to change it.

quiz.correct.where: Feedback after a right answer. Short, and green-coloured.
quiz.correct.km: ត្រឹមត្រូវ

quiz.wrongPickName.where: Feedback after a wrong answer when a picture was shown and the user had to pick the label. {name} is the correct answer, shown in bold at the end of the sentence. Pending native-speaker review.
quiz.wrongPickName.km: មិនទាន់ត្រូវទេ — ចម្លើយគឺ {name}។

quiz.wrongPickPhoto.where: Feedback after a wrong answer when a label was shown as the prompt and the user had to pick the picture. {name} is already on screen, so this describes the picture they mis-picked instead of restating the answer. Pending native-speaker review.
quiz.wrongPickPhoto.km: មិនទាន់ត្រូវទេ — នេះមិនមែន {name} ទេ។

quiz.prompt.where: Screen-reader description of the question picture, e.g. `What is this?`. Never seen visually. Pending native-speaker review.

error.saveFailed.where: Warning under the Save button when the upload or database write fails. Shown in red.
error.saveFailed.en: Could not save that. Please try again.
error.saveFailed.km: មិនអាចរក្សាទុកបានទេ។ សូមព្យាយាមម្ដងទៀត។

error.authBypass.where: Shown on the add page when VITE_AUTH_BYPASS is on locally, so the user knows saves cannot hit Supabase RLS.
error.authBypass.en: Local sign-in bypass is on, so saves cannot reach Supabase. Turn off VITE_AUTH_BYPASS and test while signed in on krumath.com.
error.authBypass.km: កំពុងប្រើការឆ្លងកាត់ចូលក្នុងមូលដ្ឋាន ដូច្នេះមិនអាចរក្សាទុកទៅ Supabase បានទេ។ បិទ VITE_AUTH_BYPASS ហើយសាកល្បងពេលចូលគណនីនៅលើ krumath.com។
